name: HMRC — Income Tax liabilities statistics + tax ready reckoner
published: liabilities tables 2026-07-15; ready reckoner June 2025 edition (2025-06-24 — still current: the scheduled July 2026 update was deferred by HMRC pending an assumptions review)

model.name: Survey of Personal Incomes (SPI) + HMRC Personal Tax Model
model.method: Liabilities tables: individual-level Income Tax estimated on the SPI, a stratified sample of HMRC PAYE/Self Assessment/repayment administrative records; latest outturn year is SPI-based and later years are projections consistent with OBR economic assumptions. Ready reckoner: direct (static plus specified behavioural) effects of illustrative changes against the indexed baseline in HMRC's personal tax model, consistent with the OBR Spring Statement 2025 forecast, implemented April 2026.
model.method_basis: Bulletin supporting documentation (liabilities); Direct effects of illustrative tax changes bulletin June 2025

baseline_key.liabilities_tables: SPI 2023-24 outturn; 2024-25 to 2026-27 projected on OBR-consistent assumptions (July 2026 edition)
baseline_key.ready_reckoner: HMRC indexed baseline, OBR Spring Statement 2025 forecast, April 2026 implementation

geographies: UK (tables 2.2 region/country breakdowns not yet emitted)
coverage_note: This build emits Table 2.1 (payers by marginal rate/sex/age), Table 2.5 (counts and liabilities by income range x band), and the full ready reckoner. Tables 2.2/2.4/2.6 are vendored in the same raw file for follow-up.
diagnosis_upstream: HMRC's personal tax model is closed-source; divergence diagnoses classified as external-model issues become a comparison memo, not an upstream PR.
